tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Open an allowed application or file on the system.

tools.name: organize_desktop
tools.description: Scan Desktop loose files and prepare categorised preview. Does NOT execute without user confirmation.

confirm.description: True only if the user explicitly said 'ordenar ahora' or 'sí, ordénalo'.

tools.name: undo_last_move
tools.description: Revert the last file-organisation action without permanent data loss.

tools.name: set_timer
tools.description: Set a countdown timer or a 25/5 Pomodoro focus session visible on the notch.

pomodoro.description: True to start an interactive Pomodoro cycle with typing scene.

tools.name: log_habit
tools.description: Increment or complete a habit among the 15 available styles (agua, pomodoro, lectura, ejercicio, meditacion, caminar, estudio, etc.).

habit_name.description: Name of the habit: agua, lectura, ejercicio, meditacion, caminar, estudio, postura, etc.

amount.description: Amount to increment (e.g., 1 for +1 glass of water).

tools.name: get_habit_streak
tools.description: Return current streaks and progress for a habit.

tools.name: draft_email
tools.description: Draft an email from an idea and present it on the island for explicit user review and confirmation before sending.

tools.name: get_wake_report
tools.description: Get summary of tasks, habits or reminders that were due while Troko was sleeping.

tools.name: set_emotion
tools.description: Set Troko's emotion explicitly: contento, enamorado, sorpresa, orgulloso, guiño, bostezo, mareado, triste, enfadado, timido, curioso, travieso.

tools.name: answer
tools.description: Respond directly with speech/text without triggering a system action.
